checks.exercise: Standing dumbbell shrug inspected in front/side preview and both encoded 32-frame sheets.
checks.equipment: Two dumbbells, neutral grip; dumbbell-only mapping.
checks.setup: Upright posture with long arms and weights outside thighs.
checks.hands: Closed grips stay attached to dumbbells throughout shoulder elevation.
checks.feet: Feet fixed throughout; head and torso stay still.
checks.movement: Vertical shoulder elevation and controlled return without shoulder rolling or elbow curling.

checks.exercise: Standing dumbbell reverse curl inspected in front/side and both encoded sheets.
checks.equipment: Two hex dumbbells; dumbbell variant only.
checks.setup: Upright stance with upper arms stationary beside torso.
checks.hands: Pronated grip retained through flexion and extension; distinct from underhand curl.
checks.feet: Fixed feet; no backward torso lean.
checks.movement: Elbows flex and extend smoothly with one-second illustrative top pause and seamless cycle.

checks.exercise: Standing low-pulley straight-bar curl inspected in front/side and both encoded sheets.
checks.equipment: Straight bar, low pulley, moving stack and connected cable.
checks.setup: Facing cable tower, upright stance and upper arms fixed.
checks.hands: Underhand grips remain on the horizontal bar; sampled bar/grip error zero.
checks.movement: Curl and controlled lowering; stack follows cable extension and bar remains between hands.

limitations: Simplified procedural anatomy, clothes and equipment; shoulders have stylized deformation at shrug peak. Dark theme thin cable contrast is lower than light theme. No full mesh-collision or biomechanics certification. Actual Android and production pending.
